question:
Which of the following is the correct chronology of these rulers?

A. Timur

B. Mahmud of Ghazni

C. Genghis Khan

D. Muhammad Ghori
solution:
The correct answer is __**B, D, C, A**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct chronology of these rulers is Mahmud of Ghazni, Muhammad Ghori, Genghis Khan, and Timur:
